title: Scaffold an Angular in-process plugin: manifest, surface, rail item, i18n, test

name.description: Human-readable name. Defaults to a title-cased id.

command.description: Also scaffold a registered command the weaver can trigger.

shortcut.description: Keyboard chord for the command, e.g. 'mod+shift+k'. Implies --command.

menu.description: Hook a menu item into a slot, e.g. 'content/tab/context'. Implies --command.

barItem.description: Also add a status-bar button that triggers the command. Implies --command.

settings.description: Also scaffold a settings section with signal-backed value owners.

about.description: Also scaffold an About dialog that reads ctx.host, plus a bottom rail item.

instanceable.description: Dock the surface and give it named saved instances, each with its own view state. Not combinable with --container: named instances exist only for a docked, non-routable surface.

container.description: Make the surface a container: a routable tab at '<id>/:id' holding a nested pane tree of child surfaces, which the host draws. Not combinable with --instanceable.

agent.description: Also scaffold the connection that lets an AG-UI agent run the commands this workbench offers: a docked panel, the seam where a call is decided before it runs, and a local stand-in that speaks the protocol so the whole path works on the first serve. Implies --command.

access.description: Auth-gate the surface and rail item: 'authenticated', 'anonymous' or 'role:<name>'.

spec.description: Generate a starter unit test. Use --no-spec to skip it.

importPath.description: Import path for the workspace alias. Defaults to the workspace scope plus the project name.

app.description: Application to drop into. Inferred when the workspace has exactly one.

directory.description: Project root, relative to the workspace root.

tags.description: Comma-separated Nx tags for the project.

prefix.description: Selector prefix for generated components and directives.

unitTestRunner.description: Test wiring to emit. 'vitest' uses @nx/angular:unit-test; 'none' emits no test target.
